items.note: S1.3.1 states the exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with restored scratch; sub-steps follow the proof: net change (JV+RG)x independent of a,c, central coefficients |S∩T| mod 2 or (|S∩T|-1)/2 cancelled by the side injection, and the three-stage composition (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x). Wire counts W_b, W_c are not given, but they are not essential to the route.

S1.3.2 states a common invertible frame per gate commuting with pointwise gates, the implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and that each edge only changes frame. It is an infer step with no method or sub-steps, so it counts as stated.

Plan gives the forms with <t_S,t_T>=|S∩T|-1 and <t_T,t_T>=2 (F_2: t·t=1), the stage transitions A'=A⊗F, P'=P⊗<t>, the side-wire chain P⊗<t_X> ⊂ P⊗t_Y^⊥ ⊂ P⊗F, the only decreasing edge being center 3->4 with loss h, gate telescoping to Wm-2N, L=Ich, and L/N=100/539 and 101/539. The existence of orthonormal bases over F_2 (lines 1073-1102) is not derived. It matters only for the complex network and is not part of the budget itself.

Rank of P_V-P_U equals the dimension change, the N negative source projections give the rank-one 2P_{U_a} exceptions, so s_b=Wm-N+2L with deficit N-2L>0. S1.3.5 gives the endpoint difference P_{U_a^⊥}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m and the shear H<-H+D on every role, scratch roles included, exactly as in the proof.

S2.1 states the phase frames, one kernel aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector and s_c=W_cm-2N+2L_c<W_cm. It drops 'or its inverse' for the kernels and says the endpoint operator is C^{⊗m} on every role without the source/sink diagonal corrections and the undoing of the signed exchange that the paper requires (1225-1227). S2.3 partly recovers the corrections. The weight-additivity proof is not given.

Strict saving s<Wm is derived from L<N/2, and S1.3.6 gives tau=1-2^{-50} via deficit >20·2^{-50} and m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20·2^{-50}). The exact eta values are not given. The condition log m<20 that justifies the exponential inequality is also missing, and the complex bound s_c/W_c<m^sigma appears only in passing (S2.7d).

S1.1 matches Lemma lem:elementary-streams. S1.2's claim omits the hypothesis that the offset be preparable in b^{O(1)} time, which appears only in its quote, and it omits the prime radix and unit conditions.

The factorization A=E_1ΠE_2 and the shear cost (triangular parts by controlled shifts in descending order, one interchange per one of Π via D_j<-D_j+H_i, swap, D_j<-H_i-D_j) follow the paper. The elimination proof of the factorization is absent. So is the choice of a fixed odd prime q avoiding all denominators and diagonal numerators (1413-1423), which is needed to specialize to Z/q^b.

All the paper's steps are present: the cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W, Φ_{A_e} per edge, the output Φ_{I_m}f_w by the contract, three shears giving the interchange, s calls, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) with the two-case geometric sum, and the depth-first parking schedule justifying the O(V) node cost.

errors.says: The complex network's edge changes are products of kernels aI+bX_v and its endpoint operator is C^{⊗m} on every role.
errors.paper: Each edge change is a product of aI+bX_v 'or its inverse' per residual basis vector (1217-1218), and C^{⊗m} on every role holds only 'after source and sink diagonal corrections, and undoing the signed bank exchange' (1225-1227; the X_a->Y_a route otherwise carries C^{-1} on 27 coordinates, 1297-1310).

errors.says: A target field can be updated by an offset computed from earlier control fields modulo q^b in O(V) time.
errors.paper: The O(V) bound holds only if the offset can be prepared in b^{O(1)} time from the control values, with q prime and rational coefficients whose denominators are prime to q (557-568).

chain: The tree reaches the main bound by the paper's route. It builds the bit network, frames, labels, the rank budget s_b=Wm-N+2L<Wm, the shear interface, the matrix-shear cost and the interchange recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1). It then reuses the complex network for the butterfly-layer recurrence, assembles transforms, ring convolution, resampling, chirp and permutation cancellation, and finishes with exact recovery and the margin table giving κ=2^{-182}. It thins out in a few places: the complex phase interface (S2.1) and the chirp identity (S6) are asserted rather than derived, the prime q in the matrix-shear lemma is omitted, and the conjugation P_M X_v P_M^{-1}=X_{Mv} behind the slot implementation is left implicit.

steps.note: The bank exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with restored scratch is fully given. The plan never fixes h=100, never defines N=binom(h,3)^3 or m=h^3, and never says the data pairs are indexed by triples in T^3. N and m are later used undefined. Rated conservatively as mentioned, though the mechanism itself is present.
The plan states a common invertible frame per gate commuting with pointwise gates, the implemented operator D_out S_Ω D_in^{-1}, and that each edge only changes frame, so only endpoint frames matter.

The plan states nondegenerate subspaces of F^{⊗3} of dimension m from triple indicators, nested labels on every edge, and the only decreasing edges as the central 3->4 edges, each losing P⊗F of dimension h.
The plan states that rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested nondegenerate labels and that the N source edges 2P_{U_a} are the rank-one exceptions.
The plan states Σ|Δdim|=Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich, derived by gate telescoping, and s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b.
The plan gives L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, so the deficit N-2L>0 and s<Wm.
The plan states the endpoint difference P_{U_a^⊥}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m on every input role, so the network applies H<-H+D on every role, scratch rows included.
The plan states A=E_1ΠE_2, exactly a interchanges (one per one of Π) plus O(V) triangular work, so a node makes s recursive calls in all.

The plan gives children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), and τ=1-2^{-50} from a deficit above 20·2^{-50} with m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20·2^{-50}), hence F_k=O(e^τ). The justifying bound log m<20 is not written out, but the inequality it supports is stated correctly.

central.summary: P05 rebuilds the central saving almost completely and in the paper's order. Frames, labels, rank equal to dimension change with the N source exceptions, the budget, the strict loss ratio below 1/2, the endpoint identity, rank-many interchanges and the recurrence with τ=1-2^{-50} are all present with their defining content. The only gap is in the setup (C1): the bank-exchange network is fully described, but h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3, m=h^3 and the triple indexing of the data pairs are never fixed.
